objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2053ms (min 2047ms, p95 2058ms, max 2058ms, n=10); in the browser: median 944ms (min 859ms, p95 1012ms, max 1012ms, n=10); platform overhead about 1109ms; about 79ms per step
